# Mixed Latin/Arabic shaping test font

Unmodified Amiri Regular is a static TrueType test fixture for explicit PDF font
embedding and mixed Latin/Arabic script and bidirectional layout. It is not a
runtime fallback or an automatically chosen document font.

- Project: [Amiri](https://github.com/aliftype/amiri).
- Official distribution: [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/39d11bc313031c9f68e21a297ce5e4a15cc5365e/ofl/amiri).
- Immutable revision: `39d11bc313031c9f68e21a297ce5e4a15cc5365e`.
- Font URL: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/39d11bc313031c9f68e21a297ce5e4a15cc5365e/ofl/amiri/Amiri-Regular.ttf>.
